mapper.select: WITH recent AS ( SELECT t.id, t.turn_no FROM conversation_turn t JOIN chat_message u ON u.turn_id=t.id AND u.role='USER' JOIN chat_message a ON a.turn_id=t.id AND a.role='ASSISTANT' WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND t.turn_no < #{beforeTurnNo} AND t.status='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY t.turn_no DESC LIMIT 6 ) SELECT r.turn_no, m.role, m.content FROM recent r JOIN chat_message m ON m.turn_id=r.id AND m.role IN ('USER','ASSISTANT') ORDER BY r.turn_no ASC, m.sequence ASC

SELECT r.constraints::text FROM conversation_recommendation r JOIN conversation_turn t ON t.id=r.turn_id AND t.conversation_id=r.conversation_id AND t.user_id=r.user_id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND t.turn_no < #{beforeTurnNo} AND t.status='SUCCEEDED' AND r.result->>'outcome' IN ('RECOMMENDED','NO_MATCH') ORDER BY t.turn_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_recommendation(turn_id,conversation_id,user_id,schema_version,constraints,result) VALUES(#{turnId},#{conversationId},#{userId},1,CAST(#{constraintsJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{resultJson} AS jsonb))
